checks: Rapid repeated fulfillment activation produces one write and one success toast.
Returned rejection produces one error toast and retains inline recovery.
Thrown write failure produces an uncertainty warning and releases the action guard.
Resident-style top-center card sits below the header; duplicate attempt is suppressed.
One stable host enters the native modal top layer; keyboard focus pauses dismissal and closing the toast preserves the dialog.
Closing a native modal preserves the existing toast without a duplicate host.
Dark theme changes the toast surface and retains the shared layout.
Long text wraps on a narrow viewport; account change clears prior-account notifications.
Unmount cleans up the portal; no uncaught browser errors.
limitations: Isolated component fixture with mocked service outcomes; no live backend writes or payment/refund operations.
